connector.name: Financial Data API
connector.registryDescription: Point-in-time macro, central bank rates and sentiment, COT positioning, from official sources.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.financialdatapi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.financialdatapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Financial Data API key. Create one free at https://app.financialdatapi.com (no card required).
